description: An encrypted record of one Telescope search attempt, written into the explorer's OWN repo when the sponsor turned on the search-history archive (search.auditPubKeyJwk present) and the explorer has an account. The whole payload — query, whether it was blocked, and the tier — is sealed to the sponsor's audit public key (a libsodium-style sealed box: ECDH P-256 → HKDF → AES-256-GCM; see docs/telescope-search.md). On the public AppView it is inert; only the sponsor's private key can open it. `createdAt` is the only cleartext field (when a search happened, never what). Retention: the device keeps the last 30 days / 500.

enc.description: The sealed payload — nothing readable without the sponsor's private key.

createdAt.description: When the search happened (the only cleartext field).

sealed.description: A sealed box: ephemeral ECDH public key + AES-GCM IV + ciphertext, all base64.

epk.description: Ephemeral ECDH P-256 public key (JWK) for this message.
